designs.title: HolaAi: AI Content Tools Platform
designs.desc: UI/UX design for HolaAi, an all-in-one AI platform for writing articles, generating blog titles and images, removing backgrounds and objects, and reviewing resumes. I designed both sides: a soft-gradient marketing site with tool cards, testimonials and Free/Premium pricing, and the signed-in app with a clear sidebar, a two-panel input/result layout for every tool, and a colour per tool so each one is easy to recognise.
designs.alt: HolaAi landing page: headline 'Unleash creativity with HolaAi' over a soft gradient, with six purple buttons for the AI tools

designs.title: CuraBot: AI Health Assistant Website
designs.desc: Website for CuraBot, an AI-powered health assistant built by our team at United International University. I designed the UI and built the frontend: frosted-glass panels over a soft DNA backdrop, quick-access cards for symptom checks, doctors, hospital beds and maternity care, and warm copper accents that keep a medical product feeling human.
designs.alt: CuraBot website home page: frosted-glass navigation, headline 'Early health assessment, right when you need it' and four quick-access cards over a DNA background
